scientific_limitations: Annealed, independently selected two-map cusp family only; fixed 1<theta0<theta1<2; not uniform at theta endpoints.
Applies only to vanishing one-sided endpoint holes and dominant killed-operator eigenvalues.
No closed formula for the stationary density at the cusp; the ratio cancels it.
Full scientific priority and correctness require independent review.
title: Quadratic dual-end escape and an inverse-square law in critical-cusp Bernoulli maps
